description: This line plot illustrates the training loss evolution over iterations for five different model configurations, as defined in the legend. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", spans from 0 to 140,000 iterations on a linear scale, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays five distinct lines: a purple line with a solid line style and no markers for "StrmLLM (n=64)", an orange line with a solid line style and no markers for "SepLLM (n=64)", a green line with a solid line style and no markers for "SepLLM (n=64, H)", a red line with a solid line style and no markers for "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", and a blue line with a solid line style and no markers for "SepLLM (n=128)". All lines begin at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid initial decline, followed by a slower, more gradual decrease as iterations increase. By iteration 140,000, all lines converge to a final loss value near 2.5. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" line (purple) starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64)" line (orange) starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" line (green) starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" line (red) starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=128)" line (blue) starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.5.
